---
title: "Nextcloud"
---

Nextcloud synchronizes documents, PDFs, media, and shared project folders. The
default local location is `~/Nextcloud`, though selected folders may differ by
workstation.

The native Nextcloud and Dropbox desktop clients are recommended for
workstations because they react to filesystem changes and provide visible sync
status and interactive conflict handling.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Alternative: rclone"}
[rclone](https://github.com/rclone/rclone) may be suitable when synchronization
is explicitly scripted or scheduled, when working with multiple servers or
remote storage providers, or when reproducible command-line automation matters
more than desktop integration. It is an alternative for those workflows, not a
replacement for the Nextcloud desktop client.
:::

Synchronization is not a backup: deletions and conflicts can propagate between
clients. Keep important local data in the separate HDD/Borg backup as well.
